steps.name: A Word That Lingers in Memory
Memories of a Feather
steps.objective: Defeat [Michaela] in 「Hyle」 and obtain a <Holy Angel Feather>. Then turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

lines.text: (Deep inside Kali, Medea senses a familiar presence and looks toward the entrance. When she spots her visitor, her face lights up with a warm smile.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Welcome, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You look as though you haven't been sleeping well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had a dream, but I can't remember what it was about. Just one word keeps coming back to me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Since you've come to see me, I imagine that word is 'witch.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems some of the witches have become aware of you, %s. A great deal has happened, after all.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I imagine Lady Iris has felt some effects as well... Perhaps we should speak with her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...That would probably be best.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What a warm breeze. Welcome, Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...
(A purple iris petal drifts down beside you, as though carried on the winds of Kali.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...
(The petal vanishes as it touches the ground, and Iris blooms into being in its place.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello, Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hi, Iris.
(Iris beams when %s waves to her, then takes both their hands.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's good to see you both.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I had meant to invite you to where I'm staying, but I couldn't. It might be dangerous for you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's happened?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I sensed an attempt to connect the Demon Realm to this world through some sort of passage.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I was relieved when its traces vanished from Eastland. But now powers great and small are reaching out in all sorts of ways.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: They are probably the beings known as lords, who rule the various territories of the Demon Realm. Lux would be among them...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And I sensed another power from within this world, trying to connect this planet to the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A witch...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Your dream may not have been a dream at all, %s. It might have been an unspoken warning.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To stay out of their way...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We have to find the witches.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know which witches are behind this, where they are, or what forms they have taken. So...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's all right, Lady Iris... I will help. Please don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then finding them comes first... We can't do anything until we know where they are.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Neither of us knows very much yet, %s, but please don't push yourself too hard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I won't. I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I should go. I only had a moment to spare, so I need to return right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take care, Iris.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Until we meet again, Lady Iris...
(Another breeze carries the warm scent of flowers past you, and Iris disappears.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh, of course. Noel sent me some lovely tea leaves. I should have offered her a cup. Too late for Lady Iris now... %s, there is something I'd like to discuss. Could you wait a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. What did you want to talk about...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Just a moment.
(A little later, Medea sets a freshly prepared cup of tea before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It smells wonderful.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Noel took great care in choosing it, so I would expect nothing less. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s... It is only a vague idea, but I may have thought of a way to find a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? You have?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When I was little, I remember playing hide-and-seek with that person. I could never find them...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But they always found me. Whenever I asked how, they would never tell me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I remember they were always carrying something when they found me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Some kind of tool?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. I cannot remember it clearly, but there was a feather attached to it. That white, sacred feather always pointed toward me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A white, sacred feather... Hmm...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There must have been more to it than that, but I think it is a place to start.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela's an angel. She should know, right? I'll head to the sanctuary and ask her.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In the meantime, I will try to remember more. There may have been something else...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will you be all right, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will. Please do not worry... I am no longer the person I once was.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Go on. I will be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back as soon as I can.
(Medea sees you off with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea's smile seems more at ease than before. Well, off to Hyle.
(Hyle is still awash in red. As soon as you enter, the angel Michaela approaches, spreading white wings untouched by the crimson light.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, it's been a while...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Michaela.
(Michaela comes closer and lightly kisses your cheek.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: That's how Mika says hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-whoa! Oh, right, your greeting. S-sorry. I'm still not used to it...
(Michaela watches %s's flustered expression and smiles softly.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you for driving away the evil presence in that faraway place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika's been well. What brings you here today...? Has that fool Barbatos shown up?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That fool—no, this isn't about Barbatos. There's something I'd like your help with...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain Medea's story to Michaela.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika understands.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: An angel's feather is a blessing. That is why other beings believe it can grant wishes.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The feather on the object that found her... It probably held the power to seek her out.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: And it wasn't from Mika's wings. Mika isn't the only angel, you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are other angels?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does that mean I might meet another angel someday? Hmm...)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is an angel. If you imbue Mika's feather with that girl's power, it can become a material for the tool you need.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika will give you a wing feather. But first, we'll spar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika will be waiting at the far end. See you there.
(With that, Michaela unfolds the wings tucked behind her back. Eager for a fight, the angel beats her white wings and flies off into Hyle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Another sparring match with Michaela... I'll just think of it as part of the process.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we go, then?
(Michaela beats her wings powerfully, whipping up winds so fierce you cannot approach.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Our sparring match is over. Wait a moment, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Michaela.
(Michaela nods and picks up a feather that has fallen to the ground. A moment later, white light spills from its tip and envelops her hand.
(In this crimson world where time seems to stand still, the sight of that light fills you with a sense of the divine.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Give Mika's feather to that girl. If it will help the goddess, Mika will share her power freely.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I hope it helps. Mika is happy too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: If you're grateful, bring Mika some cookies next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cookies? Of course. I know a place that makes great desserts. I'll bring some next time.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The Glaston cookies Argent gave Mika as a thank-you were delicious too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent brought you cookies?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum said she had cookies for Mika, so Mika went to see her and met Argent. He was trying to find a present for his little sister, so Mika gave him one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me you gave him a feather in exchange for cookies?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Yes.
(Michaela answers with an utterly innocent expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I should have brought cookies.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: But they have different purposes. The feather Mika is giving you now is more special than a birthday-present feather.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Because it's to help the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, Michaela. This feather will help everyone.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Oh, wait a moment.
(Michaela returns with two boxes decorated with pictures of cookies. She places one in %s’s hands and takes two cookies from the other.)
(She puts one cookie in her own mouth and holds the other up to %s's.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, these are delicious. Have some on your way. Give this box to that girl. Mika has another one. (Munch, munch.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for the cookies, Michaela. I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Okay. If you need help again, tell Mika. (Munch, munch.)
(Michaela pops a different cookie into her mouth, then soars into the sky toward the red moon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A red moon and an angel with white wings... They suit each other in a strange way. I have a feeling this is going to be quite a long journey...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, why did I say that? Oh, come on. Surely nothing's going to happen. Enough worrying. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, these cookies are good. (Munch, munch.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're back...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela gave me a feather infused with her sacred power.
(You give Medea the angel's sacred feather and pass on Michaela's message. Light pours from the feather, circles Medea, and fades away.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Such a precious gift... How can I ever repay her kindness?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh, what is that you're holding?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cookies. Michaela sent them as a gift for you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She gave me these as well as the feather...? I will invite the villagers to share them later.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh...
(Medea stares at the cookie box in surprise.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To think this would bring back the memory...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you remember something?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Long ago, that person told me about a certain place while giving me a snack.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A place where stars scatter like dust, making the forests, rocks, and cliffs shimmer with light.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that place...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You know it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've met a witch near there before...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If they left you a hint in the form of a dream, %s, they must have left some trace there as well.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Tell me what the place is called.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stardust Plains.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Would you wait a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Oh, of course...
(Medea gently taps %s's shoulder with her staff.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There. It is done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This will not let you find the witches right away, but it should bring them before you a little sooner, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have given you a little of my own witch aura. It will do you no harm, so there is no need to worry. Though it may make things a little troublesome...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all right with me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I hope it helps... So the place of 'night' they spoke of must be Freios. And things will begin somewhere near Stardust Plains...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You look tired. There is always a room here for you, %s. Get some proper rest before you leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was going to see Dayna right away. After everything that happened to her and her sisters...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The goddess would worry. Rest a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, if you put it like that, I can't very well refuse.
(At last getting the answer she wanted, Medea smiles faintly.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will ask the villagers to prepare a meal. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea looks so much more at ease now. She really has changed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'd better be properly prepared. This will be nothing like finding and persuading the Champions.)

steps.name: Onward to the Continent's Gateway!
steps.objective: Talk to [Dayna], then find [Jade] in 「Infinite Corridor」. Then turn in the quest to [Licota] in 「Nereis Gateway」.

lines.text: (Dayna sighs, folds the letter in her hands, and tucks it away. Then she notices %s approaching.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I was wondering when you'd come. So today's the day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I had a vague feeling. It seemed like witch business.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has something happened?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Something did come up recently. At the imperial palace's request, one of our members is already out investigating.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Though it was more of an order than a request for help.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, have you heard of Nereis Gateway?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, this is the first time.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It is a major crossroads connecting western and eastern Freios. You could even call it the dividing point between the two halves of the continent.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There are other routes across the continent, but this one is relatively safe. Unless they have a particular reason, most people pass through the gate.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You'd be better off going there and finding out the details for yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get there from here?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The road to the gate is in Stardust Plains. I'd like to make the trip easier for you, though...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Show Jade the card I gave you before and tell him about the gate. He'll send you straight there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So it really is near Stardust Plains...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If you need anything, speak to our member stationed there.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry this is all I can do this time. Things have suddenly gotten busy lately...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's fine. I'll do as you said. Thank you, Dayna. I'll head over right away.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: All right. Take care.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: (My sister has never acted in person before... Why now, all of a sudden...?)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Jade.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: What brings you here? Is it about the Magic Academy, by any chance?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Magic Academy? No.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to go to Nereis Gateway. Dayna said you could make the journey easier for me.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: That card you're holding... It bears imperial authorization.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I will send you to Nereis Gateway at once. Would you wait a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'll wait.
(Jade waves a hand, and mages of the Infinite Corridor begin gathering, one by one, in matching hooded robes.)
(At Jade's direction, the mages begin chanting. A small, rather cute magic circle appears beneath %s's feet.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Everything is ready. Now, %s, please close your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Feel the air flowing through the Infinite Corridor. Imagine you are a cat in a box, longing to leap outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A cat...?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: There we are. Now, the space-time magic will...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoooooa! A cat?!
(Suddenly, light surges from the magic circle and whisks the adventurer away with a scream.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I hadn't finished explaining...

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: Your explanation was a little long, Jade. What was that about a cat?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Someone who came with an imperial authorization card recently kept talking about that, so I worked it into my explanation.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Speaking of which, they said an important cat wouldn't come out, and it was causing quite a problem. I wonder how that turned out?

steps.name: Please Call Me Lico
steps.objective: Talk to [Licota] in 「Nereis Gateway」, then find [Edam] nearby. Then turn in the quest to [Notos] in 「Nereis Gateway」.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: The magical structure of the gate changed for an instant. Who could have done that, and why...?
(A magic circle suddenly unfolds before the girl. A pillar of light rises from its center, and someone falls to the ground with a very peculiar cry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoooooa! A cat!!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Are you %s, by any chance?
(The girl stares at the adventurer lying on the ground, then pokes them with a finger. When the adventurer flinches, she nods.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: You're alive. Let me help you up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I didn't expect you to pretend to be unconscious out of embarrassment. The Infinite Corridor must have cast that space-time spell awfully quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. But who are... Oh...
(The girl in black seems to read something in %s's expression and nods.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Yes. Exactly what you're thinking...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Oh, let me introduce myself. I'm Licota. Just call me Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you with Raclette and Jelic...?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes, I'm a colleague of the two people who insist on calling me Ri-ri-rico. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The difference is that they work behind the scenes, while I work in the open. I handle official requests from the imperial palace.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it all right to tell me this much?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Dayna said you already know about our work, so it would be fine.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm here dealing with the strange dolls appearing at Nereis Gateway.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I've heard there are dolls somewhere that move of their own free will, but these are different.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's as though someone deliberately scattered them here... As though they wanted someone to come and see...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm taking care of the dolls, so you needn't worry too much about them.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Work like this is for people like me, with ominous powers...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Anyway, if you want to know more about the situation, speak to Notos and Edam. They both work here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you say Edam?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Do you know him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We met during something that happened a while ago.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I see. Oh, there he is over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go ask him, Licota.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You can call me Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Rico. See you later.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes...
(As Licota looks around, a sudden sense of deja vu comes over her. Almost without thinking, she approaches the guardrail along the cliff at the gate.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I can feel something strange out there... Some sort of Other Side? No, I don't think so...
(A handsome young man tries to act naturally under the admiring gazes of the visitors.)
(Not quite succeeding, he forces a smile and passes them by. Then he recognizes %s approaching and breaks into a bright grin.)

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: %s! It's been a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edam? You were that ranger, right?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: You remember me... Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A ranger in Knossos told me your name. Edam...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: So that's how you know my name. I'm honored. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been fine. Things get difficult sometimes, though.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I've had a few things happen too, but thanks to you, I've been well.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I'm working here now, providing security, protecting visitors, and handling various other duties.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I've often heard of your exploits, even from afar. The effort you put into saving so many people is truly remarkable.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: But if you have come here, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something has come up, and I need to visit another part of Freios.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: It must be important... %s, you saved me. I would love to be of help. Just say the word, and I'll do everything I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're making me feel awfully obligated... Oh, has anything unusual been happening here?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Monsters and the like do appear from time to time, but they haven't been a major concern...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Let's move somewhere else. With Notos here, we may be able to tell you something useful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Edam.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Please follow me.

steps.name: The Source of the Strange Rumors
steps.objective: Talk to [Notos] in 「Nereis Gateway」, then go to the gate to 「Aie Island」. Turn in the quest to [Yeonhee], who has washed ashore on 「Aie Island」.

lines.text: (A young man with striking long blue hair and red eyes is examining what appears to be a spellbook.)
(His expression is a little tense, as if something is not going well, but he smiles brightly as soon as he sees his visitors.)
Edam, couldn't turn down the visitors' gifts again? You've come to leave them with me, haven't you?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: No, Notos. I've brought a guest.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Oh, that's a shame. I was hoping for something tasty. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Is this your guest? A pleasure to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A pleasure to meet you too. I'm... %s.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I am Notos, a mage. I am responsible for managing the Nereis Gateway Center. Visitors tend to call me the director.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah, %s... Of course. The famous adventurer who brought peace to the eastern continent...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I heard a great deal about you, even cooped up in the Sage's Tower.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not that impressive. But the Sage's Tower? You sound much more remarkable than I am...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I am merely a mage. The tower is simply a quiet place, ideal for researching wind magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wind magic... I've heard Zephyros, the chairman of the Magic Academy, is an exceptional mage too.
(At the mention of Zephyros's name, he smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Perhaps because Zephyros is indeed more talented than I am, he seems to be quite well known.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know him?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: He is my younger brother. We look exactly alike.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Hahaha. Everyone is surprised. The problem is that he hates being my twin—and hates me too. Ah...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Notos, perhaps we should get to the matter at hand?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah, Edam. Sorry. And my apologies, %s. I got carried away chatting. If Edam brought you here, it must be important...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Would you tell me what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to know what's happening at Nereis Gateway.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Hmm... As the person in charge, I must consider how much I can disclose... Could you show me something that establishes I can trust you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will this do?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: A card bearing imperial authorization. Yes, I understand. Since His Majesty himself has acknowledged you, I will tell you everything.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Nereis Gateway is a kind of terminal connecting eastern and western Freios. Its magically powered gates lead to various places across the continent.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Recently, there have been rumors of the gates malfunctioning. People have even been saying that travelers were sent somewhere else entirely.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: We have continued inspecting them, just in case. Many experts, including mages, have examined the gates and found nothing wrong.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Nor have we found any evidence of travelers being sent astray. But the recent appearance of strange dolls has fueled those rumors.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Where on earth did they come from...?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: For now, we are dealing with the dolls alongside a knight sent by the imperial palace, but there seems to be no end to them...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May I take a look at the gates?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Of course. I inspected them again today, and Edam and I checked the routes to all the highways.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I know it may be nothing more than a rumor, but do you know where the missing people are said to have gone?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: They say there is a small island somewhere among the magical vortices. A place on no map, unreachable even by gate. Whether such a place really exists...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I would like to investigate, but my wind magic cannot reach it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll let you know as soon as I find anything.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That alone is reassuring. In fact, His Majesty ordered us to trust you with the matter without asking for details, should you come, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: His Majesty did?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: He told me himself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So His Majesty knew something like this would happen...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for taking the time to explain when you're so busy. I'll go to the gates now.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Not at all. Edam, please assist %s. I must take my leave; I am expecting a visitor from the capital.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Understood, Notos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Edam. I appreciate the offer, but this is something I need to do myself...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I understand. There are several gates further inside. Please take a look.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Edam.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time to take a look at the gate...)
(As you approach the gate at the far end, the people standing before it vanish one by one, as if their very existence is being erased.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-what...?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Don't be alarmed, %s. Those people are using the gate normally.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: They only seem to be disappearing from our point of view. And they can't perceive us now, either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, what do you... Oh...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I felt something ominous just now and hurried over. I was right. Someone seems to have tampered with the gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is a witch about to appear, just as Medea said...?)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: They affected its function rather than the entire gate. That must be why the mages didn't notice...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the Other Side, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's what we know as the Other Side, though whoever did this probably calls it something else. Anyway, if we use the gate like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It should take us to the place in the rumors.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, let me come with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay here, Rico. I'll go.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm on a mission too. I need to go. Exploring the Other Side is part of my job.
(Licota's face is set with determination.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's go together.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Phew. I've found and entered the Other Side several times now... but I still get nervous every time.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Follow me, then.
(Licota and %s slowly step into the gate, as though drawn by a voice calling from within.)
(The magic flowing through the gate disperses, revealing a new place before them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are we?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Somewhere remote, neither eastern nor western Freios. I can see the landscapes of both from here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So we must be right in the middle? But that blue light over there...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Have you ever heard the saying about a voice fairy falling into the Void Sea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: This is part of the Void Sea too. The magical vortices here are even stronger than those near the Guild Union...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I think the saying refers to fairies or spirits getting swept away by the magic when they come too close.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I didn't know the flow of magic could appear as blue light like that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can see wrecked balloons and airships over there. Are those...?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: They probably tried to cross between east and west without using the gate and were caught in the vortices.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could there be survivors stranded here? We'd better look for them as we head further in.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes, %s. Let's go.
(Just then, a girl casually walks past Licota and meets the adventurer’s eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(The girl clutching a stuffed animal looks a little startled, but calmly steps back and assesses the situation.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is she stranded here?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: What? Who are you talking about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Can't you see the person right in front of me? Pink hair, holding a doll...
(Realizing that Licota cannot see her, the girl hastily flees in the opposite direction.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: H-hey! Wait!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Licota, I'm going to talk to her. Just a moment.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...What on earth did you see? A ghost...? Oh, wait for me!!

steps.name: A Travel Writer from Another Continent
steps.objective: Defeat [Pigma No. 1] and [Sock Sheep] on 「Aie Island」. Then turn in the quest to [Yeonhee] on 「Aie Island」.

lines.text: There should be a highway to the imperial capital... But no matter how far I walk, I can't find it. Nothing but dolls...
Why can't I see properly? Oh, my glasses... Those dolls took them earlier...
But it's all right! I brought a spare pair!
(The woman rummages inside her clothes and puts on a pair of glasses. She unfolds a map from her journal and looks around.)
A place that isn't even on the map. Did Hyun's bad luck rub off on me and bring me here? Sigh. I'll think about that later.
First, I'd better write this down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, can you hear me?
(The woman is so absorbed in writing in her journal that she seems neither to see the person before her nor hear a word.)
(Only after quite some time does she notice someone there. She closes her journal and looks up. Two people are watching her curiously, but she seems unbothered.)
Hello. Are you two traveling as well?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...You must be quite something to call this a trip...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you seen a little girl pass by here?
No, I haven't... Has something happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not exactly... Oh? You're from Elias, aren't you? Your clothes look like they're from there...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Elias? I've heard it's a city on the continent of Jiendia.
Yes, that's right. I came from Elias in Jiendia. Oh, let me introduce myself. My name is Yeonhee. I write about my travels.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: You look familiar... Didn't you visit Toad Village before? Your name is %s, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Oh, of course! You were there... We never really got to talk back then.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: That is all right. We can get to know each other starting now.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I am Licota, a knight serving the imperial palace of the Silvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: A pleasure to meet you, dear knight.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You can just call me Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What brought you here, though?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I was on my way from eastern Freios to the west. I was told to use the gate at Nereis.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: They said it would take me past the western ruins and on to Glaston...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: But when I stepped through... I ended up here. This is neither the road west nor anywhere on my map.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: As I explored, I learned that this place is called... Aie.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: The dolls welcomed me to Aie Island and tried to take me away. Something felt wrong, so I defeated them all, but it still leaves me uneasy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aie Island...?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I've never heard of it. Wait, you defeated the dolls here? Come to think of it, they're the same ones that appeared at the gate...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If you could deal with them...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I can take care of myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why were the dolls trying to take you away?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I don't know. Something about having a stage but no one to perform on it...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: This is a first for me. I should make a note of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Considering you're stranded, you're remarkably calm.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Thanks to a younger cousin who's been trailing bad luck around since childhood, very little surprises me anymore.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Anyway, why not gather information about these dolls? It might tell us what kind of place Aie Island is...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Shall we deal with them together, then?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait here, Yeonhee.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: The point of travel is to experience things firsthand. I will come too.
(As Yeonhee steps forward, she seems to hit something and falls to the ground. Startled, Licota rushes over and helps her up.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Are you all right? Oh, this is... One moment.
(Licota reaches out, and ripples of an unknown power spread through the air around her.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There is some sort of barrier here. Neither Yeonhee nor I can approach...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like I can cross it...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Then it cannot be helped. We will wait here as you suggested, %s. But there is something I would like you to do.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: ...Gather information about the dolls up ahead. I will analyze it as quickly as I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...That seems best. I'll go, then. Rico, stay with Yeonhee in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Don't worry. I'm stronger than I look.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm counting on you, then.

steps.name: A Spirit Holding a Doll
steps.objective: Defeat [Red Controller] and [Idle Focalor] on 「Aie Island」. Then turn in the quest to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」.

lines.text: (Yeonhee crouches before the lifeless dolls, examining them from every angle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How is it going? Have you found anything...?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: She's still examining them, but she hasn't said anything yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose it would be hard to figure anything out in such a short time.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Did you learn anything, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just as Yeonhee said, the dolls told me they needed someone to perform and tried to take me away.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Would you two come over here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeonhee? Did you find something?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Nothing major, but I did notice a few small things.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: These dolls look alike, but if you examine them closely, each is a little different.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: They vary in height, and their heads, bodies, and other parts are different sizes. And they feel pain...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I knew they were no ordinary dolls, but this is almost as if...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You're saying they're like people—no, like living creatures?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Yes... You may think it sounds absurd...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I believe you. There are much stranger things in our world... You seemed frightened, Yeonhee, so I only knocked them unconscious.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, get back!
(Licota steps in front of the group and swings her great lance. But something blocks it, sending the weapon recoiling.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Ngh...
You needn't do that. Spirits do not harm humans.
(The girl regards the group with mismatched eyes that sparkle like jewels. After a moment, she lifts the hand of the doll in her arms and waves.)
Hello...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A spirit...? Those wings do look like a spirit’s...
May I take these dolls back with me?
I will ask them not to force you to come along.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...These dolls tried to capture us and take us somewhere.
I am sorry. They were only doing their job. They did nothing wrong, so please understand.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: ...You ask us to understand without explaining anything else. There must be something behind this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What will you do if we refuse to let you take them?
Then there is nothing I can do. If you will not let me care for the dolls, I will go back.
(The spirit waves the doll’s hand once more, then quickly turns and flies away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait! Stop!

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...I don't think she's coming back.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I think you should find that spirit and talk to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, Yeonhee, would you wait here? I'll go after her and see what I can find out.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I don't like letting you go alone, but we have little choice. Yeonhee and I will stay here and see whether the dolls can tell us anything useful.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: We will wait here. Oh, you've already gone.
(Once %s disappears further into the island, Yeonhee checks her surroundings and opens her journal.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I should write down what has happened here.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Licota...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes, Yeonhee?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: That spirit said spirits do not harm humans. Does that mean... there is something here that does?

steps.name: The Singing Hero
steps.objective: Talk to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」, then enter 「Chaotic Mirror」 and defeat [Scylla]. Return to [Hayden] and turn in the quest.

lines.text: I did not expect you to come this far.
(The spirit who vanished meets the adventurer’s gaze, as though she has been waiting.)
Oh... You are beloved by the goddess. I am Hayden, a spirit who exists for dolls. And this little one is Marie. Marie, say hello.
(The spirit who introduced herself as Hayden moves the doll’s hand and waves again.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Then you must be %s. I should have recognized you at once, but I have been on this island so long without meeting other spirits that I was slow to realize.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly is this place?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Aie, the island of happy dolls.
(Hayden smiles brightly and lifts both of Marie’s hands into the air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aie Island?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Its name was originally a little longer, but people came to call it simply... Aie.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: It was an island even before the continent of Freios rose into the sky. The waves were so high that even ships could scarcely approach.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The island’s master would choose special days to calm the waves and let people visit. Fortunately, the island survived the vortices.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: It was truly fortunate that it could rise above this sea of magic and retain its form.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The master enjoys having guests and even built a theater. You should go and see it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A theater? Oh, no, that is not what I meant. Has anyone else come here besides my companions?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw a girl on my way here. Have you seen her? She was holding a doll, like you.
(Hayden, who has been chattering away, falls silent.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I cannot tell you that. If you want to know, you must find that person. It is not something a spirit like me may speak of.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That person?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone a spirit cannot speak about... A higher being? Like Barbatos, who bound Michaela...)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I will gladly tell you about anything else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to ask something she can actually answer...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marie does not move like the other dolls here.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: What...? Dolls are not supposed to move.
(Hayden quickly raises Marie’s hand to cover her own mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dolls wandering this island, saying they need people to perform... A spirit who cares for those dolls...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirits do not work for things that are not alive. So that means...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, where do I go to meet this person?
(Unable to say a word, Hayden sinks to the ground. Then, quietly, she uses Marie’s hand to point somewhere.)
(Something you had not noticed comes into view: a tree with a broken mirror propped against it, and a doll’s head lying in front. The sight fills you with unease.)
(As the adventurer peers closer, someone’s image flickers in the broken mirror.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That looks like the girl from earlier. Why is she in there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, just tell me one thing.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can go inside that mirror, right?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: You may enter the two places marked by stuffed dolls’ heads: the [Chaotic Mirror] and [Theater Eugamon]... Approach the mirror first...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that is the [Chaotic Mirror]... All right. Wait here, Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes...
(As you approach the broken mirror, light flows from somewhere and draws the adventurer into a space apart from the island.)
(The mysterious space, filled with glittering glass spheres, walls, and columns, makes you forget the island you just left.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This looks like something that could only exist in a dream. The Chaotic Mirror...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-what? Where did these dolls come from?
(Dolls appear out of nowhere and crowd around %s. As %s struggles to make sense of their arrival, a girl approaches.)
Everyone, step back. This person might become a new member of the troupe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That is not the girl who ran away on the island...)
(At a gesture from the girl, the dolls scatter. She wears a doll’s head like a hat, and parts of her own body resemble a doll’s.)
My name is Scylla.
(The girl introduces herself. One arm and one leg look like a doll’s, and a doll’s head sits on her own like a hat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Scylla?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I am Scylla, playing the role of the Doll Knight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Doll Knight?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Let me see. What role would suit you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a question. What are you doing here? I think a girl holding a doll came in before me...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: The perfect role for you is... the witch! That part happens to be vacant.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: You know the villain always appears last, right? I will be preparing in the meantime. Rehearse well and make your way to where I am.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: It will be difficult, but you must do well. That is how you earn a place on the main theater’s stage instead of remaining in this abyss.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I will see you later.
(Without the slightest intention of listening to %s, Scylla disappears. Every nearby doll vanishes with her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was that? She said her piece and vanished... She said she was playing the Doll Knight, but she talks as if we are actually performing. What am I supposed to... Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something did feel odd... Was the way she treated me part of the act too? It felt strange even for acting... Huh?
(A girl’s reflection appears between the towering glass columns further inside. Then her image appears in the other mirrors, spheres, and pillars.)
(It is unmistakably the pink-haired girl who met your eyes on the island and fled.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is she over there?
(When the girl meets %s’s gaze, her expression turns sorrowful. Her lips move as if she is trying to say something.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you saying? Help you? Oh...
(The girl’s image slowly fades, then disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...She is gone. But she must be somewhere in this place...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Scylla is the person Hayden meant, I need to find her quickly. Let’s go.
(After shaking off the swarming dolls and wandering for a long time through the space of glass and mirrors, you reach a dead end...)
(Scylla stands waiting there with her head bowed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Scylla...?
(At the sound of her name, Scylla slowly steps forward. She begins to sing a song whose mood feels strangely out of place.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I have been waiting, witch. ♬

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: You thought you could curse these people and flee where you would never be found. ♪

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I expected something like this, but she really is putting on a performance... She is not a very good singer, though.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: You imagined yourself unfortunate. ♬ You need never have become a witch...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Your choice set the idle gears of misery turning. ♩

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Surely you regretted it. No, I wish you had. ♬ But once you wielded that curse, you—!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whose story is this...? Is it really about a witch?)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Even so, the kind master of this island pitied you and let you stay...
(A mirror behind Scylla shakes violently. A dark shape sways within it, as though someone is trapped inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... That mirror behind her... Is the girl trapped in it?
(You try to push past Scylla, absorbed in her performance, and reach the mirror, but an unknown force blocks your way.)
(Scylla catches %s by the back and resumes her song.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: But you!! How dare you, how dare you!!
(Scylla pauses to catch her breath, staring at the adventurer she has cast as the witch.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I am the hero who fought and defeated demons in a land abandoned by the gods. ♬ On this island, I dreamed of a future with the one I loved...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Unable to become a doll, I endured, and endured...
(Scylla abruptly stops singing and crumples to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Scylla?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Scylla, stop that singing now.

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: To think a half-transformed Doll Knight would sing a song like that. How irritating.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Scylla, of course!

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Pull yourself together, Scylla. You must perform properly with the member assigned to the role.
(Scylla’s eyes cloud over, losing their focus. Then she raises her sword and rushes toward you.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Hehe. Commence the attack! ☆
(Scylla catches %s’s incoming attack with her bare hand.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: I do not know who you are, but I have come to my senses now. Let us stop fighting. Please, trust me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I trust you?
(Scylla releases %s’s weapon and turns her back.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: A knight would never expose her back to an enemy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...All right. I will trust you. But who was controlling you?
(Scylla approaches the mirror that seems to hold someone captive. She raises her doll-like arm and strikes it.)
Crash!
(The mirror cracks with a sharp crash. As shards tumble to the floor, someone who appeared to be trapped within becomes visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Yes. That is her.
(The pink-haired girl sits trembling, clutching a stuffed animal in her arms.)
Thank you for saving me...

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Who saved whom? Still acting, right to the end.
(An enraged Scylla reaches out and yanks the frightened girl toward her.)
Help me...
(The girl looks at the adventurer with pleading eyes.)
Why are you just standing there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are not much of an actress.
You think so?
(A smile that was nowhere to be seen a moment ago spreads across the girl’s face. Scylla’s eyes have changed again, and she releases the girl.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you, and what is Scylla?
Is that any way to address someone? I am Circe, a resident of this island and the owner of its dolls. Scylla is my doll too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The owner of the dolls?
(The girl who introduced herself as Circe waves the hand of the doll in her arms, just as Hayden did.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Yes, their owner. Dolls have been with me since I was born. They still are. Hehe. There is not a doll that disobeys me.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: So I could not believe Scylla attacked me. I was just testing my power. I wanted to know whether the witch was still controlling her...

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: What a relief. At some point, it wore off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I do not think this girl is the person Hayden meant... She does not seem quite that threatening, at least.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then why did you run when you saw me in the forest?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I was escaping in disguise, but you could see me. That surprised me. And in the end, I got caught and locked up here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then where is the witch? Why did she lock you up?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I would like to know that myself, you walking question mark.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Anyway, thanks. You kept me from losing all my dolls. Phew...

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I am leaving. Are you coming?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Scylla...?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: This is something like a doll storeroom, and Scylla is a doll. Do not worry about her.
(As soon as Circe finishes speaking, Scylla collapses. Circe glances at her, smiles lightly as though nothing has happened, and turns away.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Bye-bye, then! ☆

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is she really the dolls’ owner?)
(As you check on Scylla, you hear Circe mutter something you cannot make sense of.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I know it is for [Walpurgis Night], but is everyone not overdoing it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Circe, wait!
(Circe’s voice is gone. There is no sign of her, either.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How does Circe know about that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should find Hayden. She might know something... Oh, right. Scylla...
(The adventurer props Scylla against the wall and hurries outside. A little later, Scylla regains consciousness and sobs in pain.)

lines.speaker: 스킬라
lines.text: Ngh... Adventurer of the goddess... You must not step onto the stage as Circe wants... You must not...

steps.name: The Theater's Principal Performer
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」, then enter 「Theater Eugamon」.
2. Defeat [Glaucos] and obtain the <Essence of Aie Island>.
3. Return to [Hayden] and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (Outside, the broken mirror remains as it was, and dolls still roam the island. Hayden stands where you last saw her along the path.)
(Hayden waves the stuffed doll Marie’s hand as if she has something to say.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, you have something to tell me.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Did you... meet them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I met Circe, and Scylla, whom Circe called her doll. Just those two.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me now. Who was the person you meant...? Wait. What is that thread?
(Only now do you see the white thread wound around Hayden’s neck. It is not just around her; it seems to bind everything nearby.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this why you could not speak? Hold on, Hayden...
(The adventurer breaks the threads wound around Hayden’s neck and body. For the first time, life returns to her rigid face.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Thank you for cutting the threads binding me. They kept me from doing anything.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I did not want to become a lying spirit like Echo. I am sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Echo?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Even among spirits, one who lies to a god is poorly regarded. But %s, can you see those threads?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I put it? They suddenly became visible.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: A witch’s true power can be seen only by those touched by a witch’s power. Do you know a witch, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels a little strange to put it that way... but yes, I know one. She is on Iris’s side.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I think the other spirits said so too. If you say it yourself, %s, it must be true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then Circe is a witch? She said she owned the dolls... No, surely not...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Everything you are imagining is true. And she is waiting for someone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who, exactly?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: It is... Ah, aaaaargh!!
(Just as Hayden is about to answer, she cries out in pain and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden? Hayden!! What is wrong? More threads... Hold on. I will cut them...
The manager does not tolerate anyone disrupting the performance. Ah, forgive the interruption.
(You turn instinctively toward the clear voice. A young man with a grotesque, partly doll-like body, much like Scylla’s, watches the adventurer with vacant eyes.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: It is Glaucos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glaucos...?
(The young man smiles faintly at the sound of his name.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: He is the master of the island... But he was cursed to become a doll...
(Before Hayden can finish, she loses consciousness.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I have no idea what that spirit is talking about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I have been waiting for you, our newest troupe member. I happen to have a suitable role to recommend.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: A hero who fights a monster. Haha. Perfect for you, would you not say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Like Scylla, Glaucos thinks he is an actor... Then...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What role are you playing?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Why, as the leading member of the troupe, I am the protagonist: a tragic man who tried to save the woman he loved, only to be cursed into a monster.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The righteous hero sees nothing but a monster and seeks to strike him down.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Well? Will you take the stage?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I would like to rehearse together, but there is little time. This is an improvisational play, so much depends on the actors’ instincts.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I will put on my makeup and wait. When you are ready, enter Theater Eugamon over there and play along with the other performers.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Whether the protagonist can break his curse is up to you.
(Glaucos smiles faintly, his eyes vacant. Then he turns and drifts slowly toward the theater doors.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Scylla and Glaucos both behaved like actors on a stage. Hayden was acting too while the threads bound her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Like a puppet show put on by a witch...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait... What happens if the protagonist breaks the curse? What happens to the island?)
(As you try to untangle your thoughts, the rabbit doll beside the fallen Hayden catches your eye.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marie, stay beside Hayden for a little while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? Did I imagine that? It looked like she nodded...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To the theater. The answer must be there.
(You step into a box that looks like a doorway, and a breathtaking scene unfolds before you.)
(Rows of seats draped in red velvet and a stage furnished with scenery bring home the fact that this truly is a theater.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow. What is this place...? The atmosphere is completely different. I could believe real actors perform here.
(As you examine the stage, a commotion erupts further in. An unfamiliar girl is surrounded by dolls, looking bewildered.)
What? What are these dolls? Why are you grabbing me?
Wait, you... You are not dolls. I thought I could hide here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hold on. I will help you.
You are the key...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The key? Why are you calling me that?
We must not meet like this... My mind is fading... Rather than me, you...
(The girl sways and falls. The dolls catch her and hurriedly carry her away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop right there!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did they go? There is only one path ahead...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If this is Circe’s power, I need to hurry. There is no time to stand around...
(The adventurer leaves the stage to find the girl. As though it had all been planned, Glaucos’s narration begins.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스의 목소리
lines.text: Meanwhile, the hero visiting the island sees a woman dragged away by a monster and resolves to rescue her...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스의 목소리
lines.text: Little did the hero know that this was all someone’s game...
(As the scenery continually changes, dolls appear before %s and vanish again, as if playing their parts.)
(The play draws toward its conclusion, and at last a stage that seems to be the final act is set.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the end?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A moonlit night, the sea visible beyond the mansion... How romantic. Is that the view outside the island? No...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Outside the island, there is nothing but a vortex of magic...
(As %s gazes outward, a vast shadow looms from behind.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: A knight would never expose his back to an enemy. Now, hero. Look at me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glaucos...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait. That line... Scylla said something like that...)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Hero, you have done well to come this far. Now hear my tale.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Everything you know is a misunderstanding. That I would sacrifice a woman... Such a deed is for witches!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Yet you must have come believing I was responsible for it all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Glaucos is acting. Following a script...)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Though I wear a monster’s form, this is not my true appearance. It is a curse...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I thought taking the curse in my beloved’s place would save her... But she too was cursed and became like this. Then she was imprisoned somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could this be...?)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Having come this far, you must have a mission. For the sake of your justice.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: But I too have a reason to remain here.
(Glaucos raises the weapon in his hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel his power... He clearly intends to fight. More precisely, he is trying to provoke a fight. Which means...)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If you wish, strike down the monster I have become. Show me your justice...

lines.speaker: 키르케의 목소리
lines.text: Glaucos, stop!! Please, do not do this!!
(Circe’s anguished voice rings out from somewhere. Dolls swarm in, ready to attack them both.)
(But the dolls melt away where they stand, stopped by Glaucos’s magical barrier.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is happening...?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: %s... Messenger beloved by a god. The play I prepared has reached its end. I ask only that you bring it to a close.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Breaking Circe’s curse—that is the story of the final act.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Kill me. Then this space, imbued with all my power as the island’s master, will imprison Circe forever.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If that happens, you and the others can return home safely.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Otherwise... Ngh, aaaagh! Circe, stop!! Cir... ce...
(Glaucos’s eyes lose their focus mid-sentence. Like a puppet speaking for someone else, he begins using a different voice.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: No, Glaucos. ☆

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: %s, I do not care whether you are a god’s messenger or anyone else. You have become a nuisance to me either way.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: You know what I am going to do now, do you not?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do not want to know.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Annoying... So annoying. You are so annoying!
(The one who has taken over Glaucos’s mind seems displeased by the answer, repeating the same seething words over and over.)
(But only for a moment. As always, the dolls’ owner simply announces what awaits the next person to become a doll.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Let me tell you! You will quietly join my puppet troupe, just as Scylla and Glaucos did!!
(As %s struggles through the fight, something glints in the stage lights.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes—the threads!
(Seizing an opening, the adventurer cuts every thread binding Glaucos. His strength spent, the island’s master collapses.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Ugh... Where... What was I...
(With a strained groan, Glaucos barely manages to sit up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Glaucos?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: You may rest easy. Circe can no longer affect me. If I have regained my senses, her threads must all be gone.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If you cannot trust me, you may kill me here and now.
(An unfathomable loneliness shows through Glaucos’s resigned expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I cannot do that.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I will live on, but now I can no longer stop Circe. Ah, I do not blame you.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If this is the fate of us all, then so be it.

lines.speaker: 키르케의 목소리
lines.text: Stop, Glaucos!!
(Needles and thread fly in from afar with Circe’s voice, but the magical barrier still holds them back.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Pay no heed to her. At this moment, this stage is wholly mine, beyond the reach of even a witch’s tricks.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Now I will speak to you, the new messenger of a god. Through you, the god will become aware of their existence.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Ask me what you wish to know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I have so many questions. Where should I begin?)

choices.text: 1. About Glaucos, master of the island

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I am Glaucos, master of this island. I am the incarnation of an ancient god whose very name has been forgotten.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Do not look so surprised. You must already have met beings like me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know? No, if you are the incarnation of a god, I suppose that is hardly surprising...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I too once walked among them... It is only natural that I sense changes in the world. Though I was an incarnation, the god wished me to love this place and live here.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The god granted me a will of my own, then returned to that distant place of origin. I have remained here ever since.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: This beautiful island was always bustling with visitors to the continent. Thinking this must be what it meant to be alive, I prepared many things for them.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Then the conflict between the gods and the Twisted One began. The continent split in two and rose into the sky, and Aie Island was hidden from sight.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Visitors no longer came, but I kept writing plays for those who might arrive someday. This stage, this theater—all of it was for gods and living beings...
(Glaucos surveys the stage, filled with his magical barrier.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: That was what this stage was meant to be. And now I have made such a ruin of it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was Scylla a resident here too?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Scylla was a hero and a knight who hunted the demons appearing in Freios. While traveling by balloon, she was caught in a magical vortex and fell onto the island.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: When we found her, the shock had left her unconscious, and she would not wake. I cared for her for a long time, hoping she would open her eyes.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: She finally awoke after many years, but the world had changed greatly... She could not help being dismayed.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Still, Scylla soon found her feet and adapted to the island. She enjoyed my plays and understood them. We spent a long time sharing our feelings through those stories.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Even that was long ago now. Magic stopped her body from aging, so time has lost its meaning...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: But we were happy in those days. Then Circe appeared...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I failed to protect Scylla or this island. I could not overcome the doll’s curse, either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That is not true. You held on and came back to yourself.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Yes. That is why I have survived to speak with you, even like this...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: In any case, thank you.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Scylla and I were walking around the island when we felt powerful magic somewhere... We hurried toward it.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: A young girl lay unconscious there. When we helped her up, she quickly came to her senses.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: She looked around and smiled brightly. Nothing seemed seriously wrong. She stayed with us for a while.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: She told us nothing but her name, Circe, and that was fine with us. We only wanted to help her recover so she could go home.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: In the meantime, we forgot the powerful magic we had sensed at her arrival... Little did we know how dearly that would cost us...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: She demanded we be her friends alone and grew jealous of our bond. I could not understand exactly what she felt, but she seemed deeply unsettled.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: So we tried to send her home. We thought this was not a good place for her to stay.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: But Circe kept returning, and her obsession with us deepened. Then, by chance, we witnessed her power.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I had thought she was hiding something... But never imagined a power like that...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The power she concealed could turn anything she wished into a doll in her hands...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Scylla realized it was a power that had seeped in from the Demon Realm and tried to reason with her. But it was already too late.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Parts of Scylla’s body had already become a doll, and Circe controlled her. I tried to face Circe too, but even I, an incarnation, was powerless...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: To protect Scylla, I pleaded with Circe. I begged her to stop, but she would not. Instead, she said...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Glaucos, take all the rest of Scylla’s curse... She asked why we saw her only as a witch...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: That is enough for now. This should let the god grasp the situation. Circe has gone...
(Circe, who stood outside the magical barrier, is no longer anywhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: With her power no longer working here, she has no reason to stay.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Has anyone else come to this island?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Two people. One was stranded here, and one came with me.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Then take this and hurry to Hayden. Once you do, Circe will no longer be able to affect this island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. But what is it?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The essence that forms the foundation of Aie Island. I set it aside beforehand, just in case. Now, adventurer beloved by a god... Take it to Hayden, the island’s spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So Hayden was not originally a doll spirit, either.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will take it to her right away.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: You have done well. I will find Scylla, so take care on your way back... I will visit Hayden later...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. You take care too. Time for me to go...
(As %s moves to leave the theater, a girl appears—the same girl the dolls abducted when you first entered.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, are you... all right? Those dolls carried you away earlier.
I am all right now that I have come to my senses, key. Oh, sorry. I got used to calling you that to myself...
Thank you for keeping me from becoming a doll... If I had, everything in this world might have ended...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do not know what you mean, but there is no need to thank me. Come on, let us get out of here. The way is...
No. I cannot go with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? Why?
Because we cannot be together. Instead... I will tell you my name.
My name is Hilda. You need not remember it. We will not meet again. I will never appear before you again, either.
(Shadows slowly rise before the girl who called herself Hilda. A moment later, she has vanished without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did she go? After saying all those things I do not understand...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will think about it later. First, Hayden.

steps.name: The Reason for the Obsession
steps.objective: Talk to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」, then speak with the visitor. Turn in the quest to [Hayden].

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Are you all right, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I am fine, but you lost consciousness as soon as you saw me, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did? But I came over and handed you the item...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: So much has happened here. Thanks to you, %s, I am completely free of the puppet strings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am glad. But you were never really a doll spirit, were you?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: ...I am the spirit of the island. Together with Glaucos, I care for everything that belongs to Aie.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The dolls were here too, so calling me a doll spirit was not entirely wrong.
(The doll in her arms somehow looks as happy as Hayden herself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, how long was I unconscious? I feel a little strange...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: A day has passed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. A whole day?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes... I imagine a witch’s power had something to do with it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what happened to the others who were here with me?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The knight who wields twisted darkness recognized me, so I explained. She said she understood and helped put things in order here with the woman in glasses.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: By then, the people Circe had turned into dolls had regained their original forms. The two of them escorted everyone off the island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That is a relief... Are the people who became dolls all right?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: They are physically weakened, but rest should take care of that. They do not remember being dolls. Please do not worry too much...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Scylla and Glaucos are resting too. They would like you to visit again later, once they have recovered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I am glad they are all right.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I am glad I could meet someone who serves the goddess. When the time comes, I will go and see Lady Iris too.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Adventurer, and...
(Hayden continues speaking, but %s cannot hear a thing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, what was that? Could you say it again? I cannot hear you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. This is...
(Hayden suddenly vanishes from sight. In her place stands the witch Circe, making no effort to hide her ominous power.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: %s, I do not like you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Circe!!
(You rush toward Circe, only to be stopped by a barrier.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Shout all you like. You cannot do anything in this space. Of course, neither can I...

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: How dare you undo the blessing on my friends. I really do not like you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you trying to say? You call that a blessing?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Yes, a blessing. And you ruined it all.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: This is where I am supposed to be loved. Where the dolls who love me, and whom I love, belong!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Who do you think you are, trying to ruin everything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You turned the people who helped you into dolls because you wanted to be loved?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Yes. ☆

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I needed friends to play with. I only wanted a family who would love me...

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: A god simply granted my wish. I had no friends, so the god gave me the power to make them!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: So why? Why do they not love me? Why will they not love me?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Instead, they all tried to kill me, saying I was cursed. What did I ever do...? What is wrong with my power...?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Then I came here, and there were people who reached out to me. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Scylla and Glaucos were good friends. ☆ I like Glaucos so much.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I would suit Glaucos better than Scylla, but he turned me down. Hmph. What is wrong with me? Well, bye-bye, Glaucos and Scylla. ☆

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Then I found an even better friend. We were playing, and I was going to make her into a doll, but you spoiled that too.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Hmph. I do not like you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean the green-haired girl?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Yes, her. You saw her too. Coming here to hide—awfully careless for a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...She said her name was Hilda. So she was a witch...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then why were you trying to turn her into a doll?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Well, because she is a witch. ☆

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: She is one of those witches people talk about. Is that not what I am supposed to do?
(Circe stares at %s with an expression of complete incomprehension.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Just as Pandora did that to Luceria, I have to do the same. Otherwise, I will die too. ☆

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you...?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I have told you my story. Now I will listen to yours.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Go on. I will hear you out.
