lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you want to hear it, I will tell you. You are a fool who cannot even tell love from pity or affection.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Look at what you have done. Do you think this was the right way to make people love you? Your power became a curse the moment it caused others pain.
(Circe’s face twists.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Shut up! Shut up!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: You are going to die anyway!! I will turn you into a doll before anyone can kill you!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Then even the goddess who cherishes you will forget you ever existed!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: I will throw you to the demonic beasts as a toy!! You will be nothing but a doll with its stuffing spilling out. Just you wait!!

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Ahahaha!! Ahahahaha!! Ahahahahaha!!
(Circe’s frustration bursts into crazed laughter. A moment later, the space around them begins to shake.)

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: ...Go back to your world, then. I will go to mine. I never want to see you again, but you are already bound to the witches...

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Like it or not, we will meet again. Walpurgis Night will draw you to us.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Goodbye, then, my friend who will surely become my doll next time. ☆

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch...

steps.name: Actors on a New Stage
steps.objective: Talk to [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」, then return to 「Nereis Gateway」. Meet [Licota], find out what is happening, and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (The space where Circe stood disappears, and Hayden comes back into view.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: %s? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel a little dizzy... Ugh. Circe was here...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: A witch, indeed... She appeared with her presence concealed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seemed like the Other Side.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: An Other Side that even a spirit could not properly perceive...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Normally, the Other Side appears within a particular space. But the place Circe occupied seems to have been created by twisting the flow of time.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: ...Her will, mingled with some other power...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Enough to control even an incarnation like Glaucos and a spirit like me...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I do not know who stands behind her, but that is what a witch is: a being capable of anything she sets her mind to...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If she can control even an incarnation...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will talk to Iris about this later.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes, that would be best. But are you all right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was a little dizzy, but I am fine now. I should get going.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Of course, %s. Could you thank the knight for me on your way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Hayden. I will come and visit again.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: We were worried when you did not return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry. What happened was...
(Licota motions for silence and takes %s by the hand.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, there is no need to tell Yeonhee the details.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Oh...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Is it something I should not hear?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...Yes. Something like a trade secret. It could also have an unfortunate effect on your travel writing...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Aha. Then it cannot be helped. I will keep quiet about the dolls.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I was stranded. You brought me and the other people stranded on the island safely back. That is all.
(Yeonhee smiles brightly and holds up her journal.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Thanks to you, my time on Aie Island became a worthwhile experience. I am glad I can leave a record of it too.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Thank you, Yeonhee.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now, I can only trust her to do as she says.)
(While cleaning her glasses, Yeonhee looks into %s’s eyes once more.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was there something you wanted to say...?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Sorry. I cannot see very well right now, so I was squinting. Do not mind me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see. If you are leaving, shall I walk you to the gate?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: No, that is all right. Someone has come to meet me. When I did not arrive at the expected time, they came here themselves.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That is a shame.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: We will meet again, %s. You too, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Take care, Yeonhee.
(Yeonhee waves with a bright smile and heads toward the gateway.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: We can trust her, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we give her the benefit of the doubt?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Trust can be surprisingly fragile, like glass... But yes. Let us trust her.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I will get back to my work, then. I will be here for a while, so come find me if you need help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Take care, Rico.
(Licota nods and walks toward the Nereis Gateway offices.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I do not know where Circe went or what the other witches are doing... Should I just wait...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I go to Iris...?)
My apologies. I nearly bumped into you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I was not looking where I was going.
(Looking at the person you almost bumped into, you get the feeling you have met somewhere before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where have I seen him? He feels familiar...)
(A middle-aged man with a stern face, a deep facial scar, and an unmistakably aristocratic uniform regards the adventurer warmly.)
I did not expect to meet you here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know me?
I have heard much of your exploits, %s... Ah, I should have introduced myself. My name is Aaron. I hold a modest post in the Silvaria Imperial Council.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Thank you for all you have done for the Empire. Perhaps we will be seeing more of each other. There is the matter of the witches, after all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Ah, my guest is waiting. I must go. A pleasure to meet you.
(The middle-aged man who introduced himself as Aaron says his piece and hurries toward the gates.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was that about? Does he know about the witches too? Is it because he is a high-ranking official?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He does seem to be connected to the emperor... I will ask Dayna or Iris later.
(Meanwhile, once the adventurer leaves, Aaron, who has been watching from a distance, slowly emerges.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Such magnificent power, and I failed to take it back then... What is done is done, I suppose.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: It will make excellent bait for drawing out the witches. I should give it all the support I can...
